name: phone_robot
title: Bolt - phone stand robot: USB-C pass-through that measures your phone charging, RGB eyes
brief: A robot-shaped phone stand. Two kickstands snap out of its belly and slot through its hips to hold a phone in landscape; its head peeks over the phone. USB-C in (5 V sink) on its left foot, USB-C out on its right foot: a CH32V003 reads the charger's CC level, advertises 1.5 A or default USB power to the phone with GPIO-driven Rp, switches VBUS on through a soft-started P-FET only when it sees the phone's Rd, and measures the charge current with a 20 mOhm shunt and an INA180A2. Two WS2812C eyes show it; the gold antenna is a touch pad for night mode. 2 layers, single-sided SMT, matte black mask, white silk, ENIG.

blocks.title: Left foot: USB-C in from the charger (5 V sink, Rd 5.1k)
VBUS to the phone: P-FET, soft start
Charge current: 20 mOhm and INA180A2, 1 V per amp
Right foot: USB-C out to the phone (Rp 1.5 A / default)
CH32V003: CC detection, switch, current, eyes
The antenna: tap for night mode
